meta.name: case_decisions
meta.description: 231 (stage D, D-d4): the limits a case's decision step reads (jav/app/case_decisions.py): above a limit, the decision is made by another person than an earlier decision of the case names (the owner's decision of 2026-10-26: risk, then premium; above a premium limit the second decision is another person's). A pack's decision step names its limit; the case keeps this file as it started. limits.<name>.above: the amount (text, exact) and its currency; an amount in another currency is refused, never converted. The inv_ limits are invented for the tests and the invented product set, the az_ one a plan value of the owner's design; a live limit is the owner's decision.

changelog.note: 231 (U-A6): a plan value of the owner's design for the real corporate property product: a case whose total sum insured is above 200 000 000 HUF has its premium decided by another person than the risk.
231 (D-g): a second invented limit, the renewal's: a premium above 100 000 HUF.
231 (D-d4): the first version: one invented limit, a premium above 300 000 HUF.

inv_premium_second_person.what: Invented for the tests: a premium above it is decided by another person than the risk.

inv_renewal_second_person.what: Invented for the tests: a renewal's premium above it is decided by another person than the renewal decision.

az_authority_sum_insured_plan.what: A plan value of the owner's design, not a live limit: above this total sum insured the offer is the authority's, so the premium is decided by another person than the risk (the pack compares the evaluation's sum of the sums insured).
